passages.text: This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
passages.sermon:
This is the beginning of the gospel.
The gospel is the good news.
Jesus Christ is the subject of this gospel.
Jesus is the Son of God.
passages.original: Ἀρχὴ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way.”
passages.sermon:
Isaiah was a prophet.
Isaiah wrote these words.
God spoke through Isaiah.
God said, “I will send My messenger ahead of You.”
This messenger will prepare Your way.
passages.original: Καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν τῷ Ἠσαΐᾳ τῷ προφήτῃ Ἰδοὺ ἀποστέλλω τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου ὃς κατασκευάσει τὴν ὁδόν σου

passages.text: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’ ”
passages.sermon:
A voice calls out in the wilderness.
This voice gives a message.
The message says, “Prepare the way for the Lord.”
The message also says, “Make His paths straight.”
passages.original: Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ

passages.text: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
passages.sermon:
John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness.
He preached to the people.
He preached about baptism.
He called people to repent.
He said repentance leads to forgiveness of sins.
passages.original: Ἐγένετο Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτίζων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν

passages.text: People went out to him from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
passages.sermon:
John the Baptist preached in the wilderness.
People from all the countryside of Judea went to him.
People from Jerusalem also went to him.
They confessed their sins.
He baptized them in the Jordan River.
passages.original: καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία χώρα καὶ οἱ Ἱεροσολυμῖται πάντες καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν

passages.text: John was clothed in camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
passages.sermon:
John was a man who lived in the wilderness.
He wore clothes made from camel’s hair.
He had a leather belt around his waist.
He ate locusts.
He ate wild honey.
passages.original: Καὶ ἦν ὁ Ἰωάννης ἐνδεδυμένος τρίχας καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσθων ἀκρίδας καὶ μέλι ἄγριον

passages.text: And he began to proclaim: “After me will come One more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
passages.sermon:
John was a prophet.
John wore clothes made of camel’s hair.
John wore a leather belt around his waist.
John ate locusts and wild honey.
John preached to the people.
John said, “Someone is coming after me.
He is more powerful than I am.
I am not worthy to stoop down and untie the straps of His sandals.”
passages.original: καὶ ἐκήρυσσεν λέγων Ἔρχεται ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου ὀπίσω μου οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς κύψας λῦσαι τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτοῦ

passages.text: I baptize you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
passages.sermon:
John spoke to the people.
John said, “I baptize you with water.
But another person will come after me.
He is more powerful than I am.
He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
passages.original: ἐγὼ ἐβάπτισα ὑμᾶς ὕδατι αὐτὸς δὲ βαπτίσει ὑμᾶς ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ

passages.text: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
Jesus lived in Nazareth.
Nazareth is in Galilee.
In those days, Jesus left Nazareth.
Jesus went to the Jordan River.
John was at the Jordan River.
John baptized Jesus in the Jordan River.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ Ναζαρὲτ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐβαπτίσθη εἰς τὸν Ἰορδάνην ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου

passages.text: As soon as Jesus came up out of the water, He saw the heavens breaking open and the Spirit descending on Him like a dove.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God.
John baptized Jesus in the Jordan River.
Jesus came up out of the water.
He saw the heavens open.
He saw the Spirit come down on Him.
The Spirit came down like a dove.
passages.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀναβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος εἶδεν σχιζομένους τοὺς οὐρανοὺς καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα ὡς περιστερὰν καταβαῖνον εἰς αὐτόν

passages.text: And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”
passages.sermon: God spoke from heaven.\r\nGod said to Jesus, “You are my beloved Son.”\r\nGod said, “I am well pleased with you.”
passages.original: καὶ φωνὴ ἐγένετο ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν Σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα

passages.text: At once the Spirit drove Jesus into the wilderness, and He was there for forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels ministered to Him.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God.
The Holy Spirit acted with power.
The Spirit sent Jesus into the wilderness immediately.
Jesus stayed in the wilderness for forty days.
Satan tempted Jesus during those forty days.
Wild animals were present with Jesus in the wilderness.
Angels served Jesus while He was there.
passages.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς τὸ Πνεῦμα αὐτὸν ἐκβάλλει εἰς τὴν ἔρημον καὶ ἦν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσεράκοντα ἡμέρας πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ Σατανᾶ καὶ ἦν μετὰ τῶν θηρίων καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι διηκόνουν αὐτῷ

passages.text: After the arrest of John, Jesus went into Galilee and proclaimed the gospel of God.
passages.sermon: John was arrested.\r\nJesus went into Galilee.\r\nJesus proclaimed the gospel of God.
passages.original: Καὶ μετὰ τὸ παραδοθῆναι τὸν Ἰωάννην ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: “The time is fulfilled,” He said, “and the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel!”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to the people.
He said, “The time is fulfilled.”
He said, “The kingdom of God is near.”
He said, “Repent.”
He said, “Believe in the gospel.”
passages.original: καὶ λέγων ὅτι Πεπλήρωται ὁ καιρὸς καὶ ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ μετανοεῖτε καὶ πιστεύετε ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ

passages.text: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
passages.sermon:
Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee.
He saw Simon.
Simon had a brother named Andrew.
Andrew was with Simon.
Simon and Andrew were casting a net into the sea.
Simon and Andrew were fishermen.
passages.original: Καὶ παράγων παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶδεν Σίμωνα καὶ Ἀνδρέαν τὸν ἀδελφὸν Σίμωνος ἀμφιβάλλοντας ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ ἦσαν γὰρ ἁλιεῖς

passages.text: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
passages.sermon: Jesus spoke to Simon and Andrew.\r\nJesus said, “Come, follow Me.”\r\nJesus promised, “I will make you fishers of men.”
passages.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Δεῦτε ὀπίσω μου καὶ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς γενέσθαι ἁλιεῖς ἀνθρώπων

passages.text: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
passages.sermon:
Simon and Andrew were fishermen.
Jesus called Simon and Andrew to follow Him.
Simon and Andrew immediately left their nets.
Simon and Andrew followed Jesus.
passages.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀφέντες τὰ δίκτυα ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ

passages.text: Going on a little farther, He saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat, mending their nets.
passages.sermon:
Jesus walked a little farther.
He saw James.
James was the son of Zebedee.
Jesus also saw John.
John was James’s brother.
James and John were in a boat.
They were mending their nets.
passages.original: Καὶ προβὰς ὀλίγον εἶδεν Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ καταρτίζοντας τὰ δίκτυα

passages.text: Immediately Jesus called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed Him.
passages.sermon:
Jesus saw James and John.
James and John were brothers.
Their father was Zebedee.
They were in a boat.
They were with hired men.
Jesus called James and John immediately.
James and John left their father Zebedee in the boat.
They left the hired men.
James and John followed Jesus.
passages.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκάλεσεν αὐτούς καὶ ἀφέντες τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν Ζεβεδαῖον ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ μετὰ τῶν μισθωτῶν ἀπῆλθον ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ

passages.text: Then Jesus and His companions went to Capernaum, and right away Jesus entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and began to teach.
passages.sermon:
Jesus had companions with Him.
Jesus and His companions went to Capernaum.
It was the Sabbath day.
Jesus entered the synagogue immediately.
Jesus began to teach in the synagogue.
passages.original: Καὶ εἰσπορεύονται εἰς Καφαρναούμ καὶ εὐθὺς τοῖς σάββασιν εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν ἐδίδασκεν

passages.text: The people were astonished at His teaching, because He taught as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.
passages.sermon:
Jesus taught in the synagogue.
The people listened to Jesus.
The people felt astonished at His teaching.
Jesus taught with authority.
The scribes did not teach with authority.
Jesus was different from the scribes.
passages.original: καὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ ἦν γὰρ διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ὡς ἐξουσίαν ἔχων καὶ οὐχ ὡς οἱ γραμματεῖς

passages.text: Suddenly a man with an unclean spirit cried out in the synagogue: “What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
passages.sermon:
Jesus entered the synagogue in Capernaum on the Sabbath.
A man was there.
This man had an unclean spirit.
The man cried out loudly.
He said, “What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth?”
He said, “Have you come to destroy us?”
He said, “I know who you are.”
He said, “You are the Holy One of God.”
passages.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἦν ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ αὐτῶν ἄνθρωπος ἐν πνεύματι ἀκαθάρτῳ καὶ ἀνέκραξεν λέγων Τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί Ἰησοῦ Ναζαρηνέ ἦλθες ἀπολέσαι ἡμᾶς οἶδά σε τίς εἶ ὁ Ἅγιος τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: But Jesus rebuked the spirit. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!”
passages.sermon:
Jesus saw the man with the unclean spirit.
Jesus spoke to the unclean spirit.
Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit.
Jesus said, “Be silent.”
Jesus said, “Come out of him.”
passages.original: Καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων Φιμώθητι καὶ ἔξελθε ἐξ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: At this, the unclean spirit threw the man into convulsions and came out with a loud shriek.
passages.sermon:
An unclean spirit possessed a man.
The unclean spirit threw the man into convulsions.
The unclean spirit cried out with a loud voice.
The unclean spirit came out of the man.
passages.original: καὶ σπαράξαν αὐτὸν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἀκάθαρτον καὶ φωνῆσαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: All the people were amazed and began to ask one another, “What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him!”
passages.sermon:
Jesus taught in the synagogue.
He showed great authority.
He commanded unclean spirits.
The unclean spirits obeyed Him.
All the people saw this.
The people were amazed.
They talked to each other.
They asked, “What is this?”
They said, “This is a new teaching.”
They said, “He teaches with authority.”
They said, “He commands even unclean spirits.”
They said, “The unclean spirits obey Him.”
passages.original: Καὶ ἐθαμβήθησαν ἅπαντες ὥστε συζητεῖν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς λέγοντας Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο διδαχὴ καινή κατ’ ἐξουσίαν καὶ τοῖς πνεύμασι τοῖς ἀκαθάρτοις ἐπιτάσσει καὶ ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ

passages.text: And the news about Jesus spread quickly through the whole region of Galilee.
passages.sermon:
Jesus performed a miracle.
People saw what Jesus did.
People talked about Jesus.
News about Jesus spread quickly.
Everyone in the region of Galilee heard about Jesus.
passages.original: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἡ ἀκοὴ αὐτοῦ εὐθὺς πανταχοῦ εἰς ὅλην τὴν περίχωρον τῆς Γαλιλαίας

passages.text: As soon as Jesus and His companions had left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
passages.sermon:
Jesus left the synagogue immediately.
His companions left with Him.
James and John were among His companions.
They all went together to the house of Simon and Andrew.
passages.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἐξελθόντες ἦλθον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος καὶ Ἀνδρέου μετὰ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάννου

passages.text: Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever, and they promptly told Jesus about her.
passages.sermon:
Simon had a mother-in-law.
She was lying in bed.
She had a fever.
They told Jesus about her right away.
passages.original: ἡ δὲ πενθερὰ Σίμωνος κατέκειτο πυρέσσουσα καὶ εὐθὺς λέγουσιν αὐτῷ περὶ αὐτῆς

passages.text: So He went to her, took her by the hand, and helped her up. The fever left her, and she began to serve them.
passages.sermon:
Jesus went to Simon’s mother-in-law.
She was sick in bed with a fever.
Jesus took her by the hand.
He helped her up.
The fever left her.
She began to serve Jesus and His companions.
passages.original: καὶ προσελθὼν ἤγειρεν αὐτὴν κρατήσας τῆς χειρός καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός καὶ διηκόνει αὐτοῖς

passages.text: That evening, after sunset, people brought to Jesus all who were sick and demon-possessed, and the whole town gathered at the door.
passages.sermon:
Jesus was in the house.
The sun went down.
Evening came.
People brought all who were sick to Jesus.
People also brought those who were possessed by demons.
The whole town gathered at the door.
passages.original: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης ὅτε ἔδυ ὁ ἥλιος ἔφερον πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας καὶ τοὺς δαιμονιζομένους καὶ ἦν ὅλη ἡ πόλις ἐπισυνηγμένη πρὸς τὴν θύραν

passages.text: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases and drove out many demons. But He would not allow the demons to speak, because they knew who He was.
passages.sermon:
Jesus healed many people.
These people were sick with different diseases.
Jesus also drove out many demons.
He did not let the demons speak.
The demons knew who Jesus was.
passages.original: καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ποικίλαις νόσοις καὶ δαιμόνια πολλὰ ἐξέβαλεν καὶ οὐκ ἤφιεν λαλεῖν τὰ δαιμόνια ὅτι ᾔδεισαν αὐτόν

passages.text: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and slipped out to a solitary place to pray.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Son of God.
He woke up very early in the morning.
It was still dark outside.
Jesus got up from where He was.
He left the house quietly.
He went to a place where He could be alone.
There, Jesus prayed.
passages.original: Καὶ πρωῒ ἔννυχα λίαν ἀναστὰς ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς ἔρημον τόπον κἀκεῖ προσηύχετο

passages.text: Simon and his companions went to look for Him, and when they found Him, they said, “Everyone is looking for You!”
passages.sermon:
Simon was one of Jesus’ disciples.
Simon had companions with him.
Simon and his companions searched for Jesus.
They found Jesus.
They spoke to Jesus.
They said, “Everyone is looking for You.”
passages.original: καὶ κατεδίωξεν αὐτὸν Σίμων καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ εὗρον αὐτὸν καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ὅτι Πάντες ζητοῦσίν σε

passages.text: But Jesus answered, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus spoke to Simon and his companions.
He said, “Let us go to the next towns.”
He wanted to visit the neighboring towns.
He said, “I will preach there also.”
Jesus explained, “This is why I have come.”
passages.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἄγωμεν ἀλλαχοῦ εἰς τὰς ἐχομένας κωμοπόλεις ἵνα καὶ ἐκεῖ κηρύξω εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ ἐξῆλθον

passages.text: So He went throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
passages.sermon: Jesus traveled through all of Galilee.\r\nHe preached in their synagogues.\r\nHe drove out demons.
passages.original: καὶ ἦλθεν κηρύσσων εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς αὐτῶν εἰς ὅλην τὴν Γαλιλαίαν καὶ τὰ δαιμόνια ἐκβάλλων

passages.text: Then a leper came to Jesus, begging on his knees: “If You are willing, You can make me clean.”
passages.sermon:
A man had leprosy.
He came to Jesus.
He begged Jesus for help.
He knelt down before Jesus.
He spoke to Jesus.
He said, “If you are willing, you can make me clean.”
passages.original: Καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν λεπρὸς παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν καὶ γονυπετῶν καὶ λέγων αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι

passages.text: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”
passages.sermon:
Jesus felt compassion.
Jesus reached out His hand.
Jesus touched the man.
Jesus said, “I am willing.”
Jesus said, “Be clean!”
passages.original: Καὶ σπλαγχνισθεὶς ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἥψατο καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Θέλω καθαρίσθητι

passages.text: And immediately the leprosy left him, and the man was cleansed.
passages.sermon: Jesus healed the man with leprosy.\r\nThe leprosy left the man at once.\r\nThe man became clean immediately.
passages.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα καὶ ἐκαθαρίσθη

passages.text: Jesus promptly sent him away with a stern warning: “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus had just healed a man with leprosy.
Jesus spoke to the man with a stern warning.
Jesus sent the man away immediately.
Jesus said, “Do not tell anyone.”
Jesus said, “Go and show yourself to the priest.”
Jesus said, “Offer the gift Moses commanded for your cleansing.”
Jesus said, “This will be a testimony to them.”
passages.original: Καὶ ἐμβριμησάμενος αὐτῷ εὐθὺς ἐξέβαλεν αὐτόν καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ὅρα μηδενὶ μηδὲν εἴπῃς ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε σεαυτὸν δεῖξον τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ προσένεγκε περὶ τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ σου ἃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς

passages.text: But the man went out and openly began to proclaim and spread the news. Consequently, Jesus could no longer enter a town in plain view, but He stayed out in solitary places. Yet people came to Him from every quarter.
passages.sermon:
Jesus healed a man with leprosy.
The man left Jesus.
The man began to speak to many people.
He spread the news about Jesus everywhere.
Because of this, Jesus could not enter towns openly.
Jesus stayed outside in lonely places.
People still came to Jesus from every direction.
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ ἐξελθὼν ἤρξατο κηρύσσειν πολλὰ καὶ διαφημίζειν τὸν λόγον ὥστε μηκέτι αὐτὸν δύνασθαι φανερῶς εἰς πόλιν εἰσελθεῖν ἀλλ’ ἔξω ἐπ’ ἐρήμοις τόποις ἦν καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντοθεν
